_meta.name: Birdspot F1 progress to 140 photographed species
_meta.authority: User-approved sequencing 2026-11-13. This is a progress index, NOT the canonical 9-point status.
_meta.progressMethod: Count 100 canonical audited items plus unique individually first-pass-reviewed canonical audited:false IDs; no duplicates. expectedFirstPass/expectedRemaining are cross-checks and must be updated together.
_meta.nextGate: When all 140 have initial documented review, independently and comprehensively reverify ALL 140; only afterwards work on species outside the group of 140.
_meta.limits: No source, license, age/sex or complete audit is promoted by this index. Do not alter canonical audited/verdict fields based on progress alone.
